[[File:Lumbridge Teleport icon (mobile).png|left|class=pageimage]]
'''Lumbridge Teleport''' teleports the caster to [[Lumbridge]]. Unlike the free [[Lumbridge Home Teleport]] spell, this is fast and cannot be interrupted by combat, though like most other teleports, it is unusable above level 20 [[Wilderness]] or when the player is [[teleblock]]ed. Players returning to Lumbridge may save [[runes]] by using the free teleport instead, if they are not in danger.

Casting this spell is a requirement for the [[medium Lumbridge & Draynor]] diary.
